This is a '''list of Rhodes Scholars''', covering ''notable'' people who have received a [[Rhodes Scholarship]] to the [[University of Oxford]] since its 1902 founding, sorted by the year the scholarship started and student surname. All names are verified using the [https://www.rhodeshouse.ox.ac.uk/scholars-alumni/rhodes-scholar-database/ Rhodes Scholar Database]. This is ''not'' an exhaustive list of all Rhodes Scholars.
